svg.text: In-class bench DC supply (never from RP4)
;All grounds common: RP4 GND, bench supply GND, U3 pins 4,5,12,13.
;U2 is the on/off enable only (no PWM). EN pulled low by R2, so the
; motor is disabled whenever GPIO24 is low or floating (incl. boot).
;R3-R6 hold driver inputs low while RP4 GPIOs float at boot.
;U3 outputs have internal clamp diodes; no external flyback diodes.
;Coil V ≈ 12 V − ~2.1 V driver drop ≈ 9.9 V → ≈0.27 A/phase.
;Rev B 2026-11-11: circuit rebuilt from scratch; coil pairs
; re-verified by resistance (A: GRN/GRY, B: RED/YEL). Schematic
; verified against build. Bypass C1, C2 = 100nF only.
